2607.11530.title: Learning Residual Kinematic Corrections for Continuous Neural Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
2607.11530.paper_summary: Decoding continuous three-dimensional (3D) motor imagery (MI) using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain--computer interfaces (BCIs) remains challenging due to signal variability and residual decoding errors. Deep learning architectures such as convolutional neural network--long short-term memory (CNN--LSTM) models can capture spatial and temporal dynamics for continuous kinematic decoding; however, systematic residual errors persist in predicted trajectories. We propose a two-stage decoding framework that applies reinforcement learning (RL) to perform residual kinematic correction on the outputs of a CNN--LSTM decoder (CNN--LSTM--RL). The RL agent is trained offline without direct EEG input and instead operates on predicted kinematic trajectories to optimize movement accuracy relative to target trajectories. Decoding performance was quantified using Pearson correlation coefficients ($r$) and Root Mean Square Errors (RMSE) along the $x, y$, and $z$ axes. Compared to CNN--LSTM applied alone, CNN--LSTM--RL improved the mean correlation from $0.5076$ to $0.7181$ ($p = 0.0005$) in 2D and from $0.6420$ to $0.7780$ ($p = 0.0059$) in VR, with relative gains of $41.5\%$ and $21.2\%$, respectively. Correspondingly, RMSE was reduced from $0.0890$ to $0.0532$ (2D, $p < 0.0001$) and from $0.0714$ to $0.0441$ (VR, $p < 0.0001$), representing relative reductions of $40.2\%$ and $38.2\%$. These findings demonstrate that this scalable framework enhances 3D BCI MI decoding by correcting kinematic errors via offline residual RL without extra neural data, advancing neurorehabilitation, prosthetics, and virtual interaction.
2607.11530.paper_summary_zh: 解碼連續三維 (3D) 動作意象 (MI) 使用非侵入性腦電圖 (EEG) 基於腦-電腦介面 (BCI) 仍然具有挑戰性，因為信號變異性和殘餘解碼錯誤。深度學習架構如卷積神經網絡-長短期記憶 (CNN-LSTM) 模型可以捕捉連續運動學解碼的空間和時間動態；然而，預測軌跡中仍然存在系統性的殘餘錯誤。我們提出了一個兩階段解碼框架，應用強化學習 (RL) 對 CNN-LSTM 解碼器 (CNN-LSTM-RL) 的輸出進行殘餘運動學修正。RL 代理在沒有直接 EEG 輸入的情況下進行離線訓練，而是基於預測的運動學軌跡來優化相對於目標軌跡的運動準確性。解碼性能通過皮爾森相關係數 ($r$) 和均方根誤差 (RMSE) 在 $x, y$ 和 $z$ 軸上進行量化。與單獨應用 CNN-LSTM 相比，CNN-LSTM-RL 在 2D 中將平均相關性從 $0.5076$ 提高到 $0.7181$ ($p = 0.0005$)，在 VR 中從 $0.6420$ 提高到 $0.7780$ ($p = 0.0059$)，相對增益分別為 $41.5\%$ 和 $21.2\%$。相應地，RMSE 從 $0.0890$ 降至 $0.0532$ (2D, $p < 0.0001$) 和從 $0.0714$ 降至 $0.0441$ (VR, $p < 0.0001$)，分別代表 $40.2\%$ 和 $38.2\%$ 的相對減少。這些發現表明，這個可擴展的框架通過離線殘餘 RL 修正運動學錯誤，增強了 3D BCI MI 解碼，無需額外的神經數據，推進了神經康復、義肢和虛擬互動。
